title: HAMECHI MANZOR DARE
medium: live audio-reactive canvas 2D: sprite fire, a pressure-ring swarm, a mask state machine
summary: A paranoia piece: everything means something. One screaming figure, surrounded by a swarm of eyes, whispering mouths and pointed words that closes in as the track builds; the head on fire; masks that slam on during calm phrases, crack on bass hits and tear off on the loudest one.

cuts.name: reel
cuts.note: the loudest 60 s; t0 snaps to the nearest beat and the audio mux must use the snapped value

gallery.alt: A white line-drawn figure on black, his head on fire, in a swarm of small eyes, arrows and Persian words. A blank white mask covers his face and cracks, then tears off on the loudest hit: underneath, he is screaming.
